sql.owned_image: SELECT media_id,storage_key,access_scope,mime_type,file_size FROM n_media_assets WHERE media_id=:media_id AND owner_user_id=:viewer_id AND media_type='image' AND status='ready' AND access_scope IN ('public','post')
sql.lock_owned_image: SELECT media_id FROM n_media_assets WHERE media_id=:media_id AND owner_user_id=:viewer_id AND media_type='image' AND status='ready' AND access_scope IN ('public','post') FOR UPDATE
sql.image_is_attached:
SELECT 1 AS in_use FROM n_media_assets asset
WHERE asset.media_id = :media_id AND (
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media WHERE media_id = asset.media_id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media WHERE media_id = asset.media_id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_users WHERE avatar_media_id = asset.media_id)
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_groups g WHERE
      TRIM(g.avatar_url) IN (asset.public_url, asset.thumbnail_url)
      OR TRIM(g.cover_url) IN (asset.public_url, asset.thumbnail_url)
      OR (asset.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND (
        REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(g.avatar_url), '^https?://[^/]+|[?#].*$', '', 1, 0, 'i')
          IN ('/storage/' || asset.storage_key, '/uploads/' || asset.storage_key, '/upload/' || asset.storage_key)
        OR REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(g.cover_url), '^https?://[^/]+|[?#].*$', '', 1, 0, 'i')
          IN ('/storage/' || asset.storage_key, '/uploads/' || asset.storage_key, '/upload/' || asset.storage_key)
      ))
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_group_posts gp WHERE gp.media_urls IS NOT NULL AND (
      (asset.public_url IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(',' || TRIM(gp.media_urls) || ',', ',' || asset.public_url || ',') > 0)
      OR (asset.thumbnail_url IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(',' || TRIM(gp.media_urls) || ',', ',' || asset.thumbnail_url || ',') > 0)
      OR (asset.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(',' || TRIM(gp.media_urls) || ',',
          '(, *)(https?://[^/,?#]+)?/(storage|uploads|upload)/([^,?# ]+)([?#][^,]*)? *',
          ',/storage/\4', 1, 0, 'i'),
        ',/storage/' || asset.storage_key || ',') > 0)
    )
  )
)
sql.write_alt_text: UPDATE n_media_assets SET alt_text=:alt_text WHERE media_id=:media_id AND owner_user_id=:viewer_id
sql.moderation_images: SELECT a.media_id,a.storage_key,a.access_scope,a.mime_type,a.file_size FROM n_posts p JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=p.author_id AND author.is_active=1 JOIN n_post_media pm ON pm.post_id=p.post_id JOIN n_media_assets a ON a.media_id=pm.media_id AND a.owner_user_id=p.author_id WHERE p.post_id=:post_id AND p.visibility='public' AND p.is_deleted=0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id,p.post_id)=1 AND a.media_type='image' AND a.status='ready' AND a.access_scope='public' ORDER BY pm.sort_order,a.media_id FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY
sql.moderation_image: SELECT a.media_id,a.storage_key,a.access_scope,a.mime_type,a.file_size FROM n_posts p JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=p.author_id AND author.is_active=1 JOIN n_post_media pm ON pm.post_id=p.post_id JOIN n_media_assets a ON a.media_id=pm.media_id AND a.owner_user_id=p.author_id WHERE p.post_id=:post_id AND p.visibility='public' AND p.is_deleted=0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id,p.post_id)=1 AND a.media_type='image' AND a.status='ready' AND a.access_scope='public' AND a.media_id=:media_id
sql.moderation_group_images: SELECT a.media_id,a.storage_key,a.access_scope,a.mime_type,a.file_size FROM n_group_posts p JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.privacy='public' AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0 JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=p.author_id AND author.is_active=1 JOIN n_media_assets a ON a.owner_user_id=p.author_id AND a.media_type='image' AND a.status='ready' AND a.access_scope='public' WHERE p.post_id=:post_id AND p.is_deleted=0 AND fn_can_view_group(:viewer_id,g.group_id)=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id=p.author_id) OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id=p.author_id)) AND INSTR(',' || TRIM(p.media_urls) || ',', ',' || a.public_url || ',')>0 ORDER BY INSTR(',' || TRIM(p.media_urls) || ',', ',' || a.public_url || ','),a.media_id FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY
sql.moderation_group_image: SELECT a.media_id,a.storage_key,a.access_scope,a.mime_type,a.file_size FROM n_group_posts p JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.privacy='public' AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0 JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=p.author_id AND author.is_active=1 JOIN n_media_assets a ON a.owner_user_id=p.author_id AND a.media_type='image' AND a.status='ready' AND a.access_scope='public' WHERE p.post_id=:post_id AND p.is_deleted=0 AND fn_can_view_group(:viewer_id,g.group_id)=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id=p.author_id) OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id=p.author_id)) AND INSTR(',' || TRIM(p.media_urls) || ',', ',' || a.public_url || ',')>0 AND a.media_id=:media_id
